messages:
Ava Chen: Quick heads-up — planning to run an A/B pricing experiment on reserved tiers next Wed (2026-05-06). Need to lock grandfathering rules and rollout owners.

Diego Martinez: timeline + cohort sizes?

Ava Chen: Go-live 2026-05-06 09:00 UTC. Cohort A = 20% (control, current pricing), Cohort B = 20% (new price sheet). Rest see fallback. Grandfathering: customers with first invoice before 2026-05-06 get 6 months protection unless they opt-in. Legal ok with that?

Priya Singh: borderline — legal prefers explicit opt-in for any price increase, but grandfathering for existing contracts is fine. I'll loop in @Legal and draft an opt-in email. Also need support playbook.

Marta Novak: SalesOps — we'll need the list export by MRR buckets. Suggest cutoff: customers with avg monthly spend > $5k get dedicated lift (manual outreach). I'll own the export. @Ethan can you add tag `pricing_experiment=B` to customers in cohort?

Ethan Brooks: Yep — will add tags. Also add telemetry flags so product can emit `pricing.variant` in events. What's the main success metric? ARPU? net churn?

Ava Chen: Primary metric = rev per active customer (30d), secondary = churn and #support tickets. We'll run 14-day evaluation window and pause on >5% negative delta.

BillingBot: Generated 5 test invoices for cohort B in staging — invoice ids: inv_test_1001..inv_test_1005. https://staging.billing.redwood/invoices

Diego Martinez: Pro-rating — if a customer is mid-billing cycle, do we pro-rate or apply at next invoice?

Priya Singh: Pro-rate on next invoice. Avoid surprise credits. Add note in announcement.

Ava Chen: Need Finance sign-off by 2026-05-01 EOD. Who can approve?

Marta Novak: I'll approve the cohort list. @Ava please add the legal thread link. :thumbsup:

Priya Singh: I'll own comms + support doc. Draft ready tomorrow.

Ethan Brooks: tagging done. I'll coordinate with eng to ensure feature flags are in place.

Diego Martinez: I'll run the forecast sim later today and push numbers to the sheet.

Ava Chen: Great — final checklist:
```
- SalesOps list (Marta)
- Legal opt-in review (Priya)
- Finance sign-off (Diego)
- Telemetry & flags (Ethan)
- Staging invoice sanity (BillingBot)
- Comms (Priya)
```

Ava Chen: If no objections, we'll push to canary 2026-05-04 and full roll 2026-05-06. Thanks everyone.
